changelog:
- Unified Command Card: Eliminated dual bottom toolbar on start page, routing all homescreen search to the center Command Input Card.
- Expandable Command Card: Card dynamically expands on focus/typing for spacious text entry without arrow button.
- Bottom Shortcuts with Carousel: Anchored shortcuts to bottom of start screen with Manage Shortcuts above, featuring 2x2 horizontal swipe paging and dot indicators.
- Native Menu Sheet: Three-dots on Command Card opens the native browser menu.
